title: Comparison direct image
statement:
Let $u:U\to V$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let
$L\in\Dplus(U_{\Et},\Lambda)$. There is a natural isomorphism

$$
 \nu_V^*Ru_{\Et,*}L
 \xrightarrow{\sim}
 Ru_{\Proet,*}\nu_U^*L.
$$

It is compatible with identities, composites, and morphisms of $L$.

proof.text: Use the existing canonical underived mate lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange. The library theorem isIso_lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange proves it invertible for a qcqs morphism, using affine pro-etale presentations and continuity of sections. No replacement comparison or arbitrarily chosen isomorphism is introduced.

For each injective etale sheaf I, the existing rightAcyclic_lowerStar_comparisonUpperStar_obj_of_injective makes its comparison pullback acyclic for pro-etale direct image. This is the direct-image consequence of the comparison-injective-acyclicity node, in the same source module. Apply Functor.isIso_rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_of_rightAcyclic to the actual underived mate isomorphism. This proves invertibility of the specified derived base-change transformation, as in the source library comparison theorem, rather than merely existence of some isomorphism.

For identity compatibility, evaluate the restriction square on each object: the two pullback identity morphisms agree. Apply injectivity of the comparison adjunction homEquiv and unit_mateEquiv_symm to obtain the underived identity law. For composition, similarly evaluate the restriction square against the pullback composition isomorphisms, then use naturality of the units and unit_mateEquiv_symm to prove the underived mate composition law. These calculations use the canonical site restriction squares directly, without importing an additional pullback-coherence theorem.

proof.text: Lift both equalities to bounded-below derived categories by the universal property Functor.rightDerived_ext. After precomposing with the derived unit, expand the defining factorization equations for derived base change, derived identity and derived composition. Naturality of the comparison factorization and the underived equality identify the two sides. For composition, obtain preservation of injectives for both direct images from their exact inverse-image adjunctions. Specializing these generic calculations gives exactly the displayed identity and composition formulas with the existing composition isomorphisms. Naturality in the complex is already built into the natural transformation.
